summary: The team is balancing urgent operational fixes with strategic pushes on SEO, program promotion, and the upcoming CKGSB-IE Report launch, while refining the knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: This week, the immediate priority is resolving the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding the account with updated credentials, checking other devices, and coordinating with JSB for unlock—this is blocking communications. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward: the team decided to keep the current site as a base, remove the videos panel, and integrate videos into topic sections; Joseph needs to share his HTML file and gather feedback from Julie and others to finalize enhancements. On the marketing front, SEO and program promotion are focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph preparing a conversion tracking brief and the team auditing current setups and analyzing participant data to optimize campaigns. Looking ahead, the CKGSB-IE Report launch on Sept 15 is a major upcoming milestone: several action items are due Sept 9, including sharing promotional materials, press releases, and drafts with IE, finalizing the luncheon speaker (Dean Xiang replaces Prof Li Wei), and coordinating logistics for the Tech in Asia event—these require immediate attention to meet deadlines. Additionally, the team is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China over US partnerships, with Berkeley as a potential third priority if resources allow.
